build_FrozenInTime_model: build a FrozenInTime model with SpaceTimeTransformer video backbone and RoBERTa text encoder for fused vision-language tasks
run_forward_cross_attention: run the forward pass of FrozenInTime to compute fused video-text embeddings via cross-attention blocks
compute_text_embeddings: compute text embeddings from tokenized input using the RoBERTa encoder in FrozenInTime
compute_video_embeddings: compute video embeddings from video tensor input using the SpaceTimeTransformer in FrozenInTime
calculate_similarity_matrix: calculate cosine similarity matrix between two sets of normalized embeddings using sim_matrix
